verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for an inference platform like Baseten, but nothing in the evidence describes an API explorer, try-it console, or runnable examples. The docs do offer llms.txt, markdown pages and an MCP server, but none of these is an interactive, runnable API reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path, which is further sign there is no spec-driven interactive reference.
